title: Handle cross-checkpoint changes without losing the route
summary: For a significant change, record the request and paused position, inspect known dependencies and code, explain affected checkpoints to Lohith, then implement the agreed scope. Preserve earlier versions; reopen only affected work. Commit one coherent change with a meaningful task label.
body: A dependency query finds recorded links only; it is not a semantic oracle. Commit with explicit file paths and inspect staged diff; never include unrelated dirty changes, .env, raw logs or generated resumes. A technical completion uses review status; accepted requires the actual user statement and source. That record is provenance, not cryptographic proof of human identity.
change_reason: Initial migration: preserve source context and current user intent
